module.description: Implement a module of a 16-bit full adder in combinational logic.

ports.input: Carry-in input. The module name "Cin" is case-sensitive.
ports.output: 16-bit output representing the sum of A and B.
Carry-out output. The module name "Co" is case-sensitive.

module.implementation: In the adder_16bit module, you need to design a small bit-width adder(8-bit adder), which will be instantiated multiple times. The 8-bit adder module utilizes a series of bit-level adders (full adders) to perform the addition operation.
